|translation='''Title:''' Improved TIE laser cannon.

'''Card text:'''
Use 1 Force to deploy on a TIE. A capital is hit if (destiny − 2) > armor. A starfighter is hit if destiny > maneuver.

'''Lore:'''
Sienar Fleet Systems' latest prototype laser cannon. It can be fitted on almost every Imperial TIE and raises firepower, but many Moffs think it costs too much for mass deployment.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed title is 改良型タイ・レーザー・キャノン (improved TIE laser cannon).
